szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity Context API is live.

Context API reads up to 10 URLs per call and returns clean .md, HTML, links, and snippets per page.

We tested Context API against Firecrawl, Exa, Parallel, Keenable, and Contextdev on thousands of URLs from real agent requests.

Context API returned usable content for 92.3% of URLs, 87.9% fact recall, and 80.3% content precision at $1/1000 URLs fetched.

By default, a page fetched in the last two days comes from Perplexity's web index; otherwise, it's fetched live.

Read more: pplx.ai/context-api 

The Context API is available now at:
 https://lnkd.in/grMfUS8E
